claim: Patchline ships a threats-to-validity matrix mapping every threat to a robustness or ablation experiment. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the threats-to-validity matrix claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make threats-validity-matrix-2-gate`.
